response.sql:
WITH acct AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
reg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS figure
  FROM acct
  GROUP BY region
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg
)
SELECT reg.region,
       reg.figure,
       reg.figure - overall.overall_avg AS excess_over_avg,
       reg.figure / overall.overall_avg AS ratio_to_avg
FROM reg CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE reg.figure > overall.overall_avg
ORDER BY reg.figure DESC;

assumptions.assumption: All transactions count, whatever their type (PRIJEM, VYDAJ, VYBER), using trans.amount as stored (unsigned), since the request asks to average trans.amount without any sign adjustment or filter.
Accounts with no transactions have no per-account average and are left out. Regions with no such accounts do not appear.
The 'average across all regions' is the simple average of the regional figures, with each region weighted equally. It is not weighted by the number of accounts.
